scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:ts
scripts.test:e2e:docker:br: pnpm run test:e2e:docker:build && pnpm run test:e2e:docker:run
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:dev: pnpm run test:e2e:docker:br pnpm --dir tests run test:e2e:server:dev
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:node: pnpm run test:e2e:docker:br pnpm --dir tests run test:e2e:server:node
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:static: pnpm run test:e2e:docker:br pnpm --dir tests run test:e2e:server:static
scripts.test:e2e:server:dev: cross-env NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3000 PORT=3000 VIO_SERVER=development pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:server:node: cross-env NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="$(mkcert -CAROOT)/rootCA.pem" NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3001 PORT=3001 VIO_SERVER=node pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:server:static: cross-env NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3002 PORT=3002 VIO_SERVER=static pnpm run test:e2e
